files.source: Biopython 1.85, installed at /usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/Bio/Restriction/Restriction_Dictionary.py (the interpreter backend/.venv exposes via --system-site-packages; `import Bio; Bio.__version__ == '1.85'`). REBASE-derived enzyme table: recognition site, size, fst5/fst3 cut offsets, ovhg, ovhgseq, compsite regex, suppliers.

files.source: Biopython 1.85, installed at /usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/Bio/Restriction/Restriction.py. Defines the search semantics the subject delegates to: FormattedSeq normalisation, 1-based positions, the `location + fst5` cut rule, linear vs circular search, and catalyse() fragmenting.

Biopython 1.85, installed at /usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/Bio/Data/IUPACData.py. Authority for the IUPAC ambiguity codes used to expand degenerate recognition sequences and for what counts as a nucleotide letter.

files.source: Pinned TEST INPUT, not an oracle: the 2686-base pUC19 sequence already committed in this repo at backend/tests/_puc19.py (its docstring cites GenBank L09137.2), written out as one line plus a trailing newline. Pinned so the byte-for-byte input to every expected value in gx/register.json is fixed even if the fixture module moves.
